claims.claim: For t : Set GHSpace with a uniform doubling constant n (per-member closedBall c (2r) coveringNumber <= n) and a uniform scale bound univ subset closedBall y (2R), the RHS of D12 uniformCovers_of_totallyBounded holds: uniform diameter bound and, for every eps > 0, a single K with #s <= K and univ subset of open eps-balls for every p in t.
Same with per-member radii Rp controlled by a uniform R (Rp p <= R).
Family-level quantitative covering bound with explicit constant n^(k+2) at every member.
ENat/ENNReal coveringNumber <= K converts to an explicit finite cover by open balls of radius eps > delta (closed vs strict ball, <= vs < bookkeeping).
The round-3 pair-level GH-transfer theorem is consumed (not reproved) at family level.

Direction check: the fed direction is uniform covers => totally bounded/compact (mpr of totallyBounded_iff_uniformCovers, isCompact_of_uniformCovers); TotallyBounded is never assumed and gromovCriterion is unused.
claims.status: proved; enforced by driver source checks

claims.claim: Non-vacuous finite witness: for every N the finite family {discGH m | m <= N} satisfies both hypotheses (n = N+1, R = 1), has N+1 distinct members, and the conclusion holds with sharp K = N+1 at eps = 1/2 and with the explicit quantitative constant (N+1)^5 at delta = 1/4.

The uniform doubling hypothesis is not free: the infinite family of all finite discrete spaces satisfies the same uniform scale bound but no finite K gives uniform 1/2-covers, and no uniform doubling constant exists for it.
